description: Source code for network request and response handling in Playwright's core server, including classes for Request, Response, WebSocket, and routing logic, as well as cookie and header utilities.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including methods for managing headers, response, and overrides.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, providing access to status, headers, body, and related metadata.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection with event handling for frames and errors.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request routing, including handling, aborting, fulfilling, and continuing requests.

methods.name: filterCookies
methods.description: Filters cookies based on URL matching and security criteria.

methods.name: isLocalHostname
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is local (localhost or ends with .localhost).

methods.name: applyHeadersOverrides
methods.description: Merges and filters headers, respecting forbidden headers.

methods.name: rewriteCookies
methods.description: Rewrites cookie properties based on URL parsing and validation.

methods.name: parseURL
methods.description: Parses a string into a URL object, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: stripFragmentFromUrl
methods.description: Removes URL fragment (hash) from a URL string.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Returns the standard status text for a given HTTP status code.

methods.name: singleHeader
methods.description: Creates a headers array with a single header.

methods.name: mergeHeaders
methods.description: Merges multiple headers arrays into one, preserving case and avoiding duplicates.
